name: Sikagard-552 W Aquaprimer
paste:
SIKAGARD®-552 W AQUAPRIMER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer, April 2023, Version 03.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikagard_-552_w_aquaprimer.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer is a one-component water dispersed adhesion promoting primer for water dispersed polymer paint coatings.
    - Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer is part of a system that complies with the requirements of EN 1504-2 as a protective coating.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Priming coat for concrete and dense mineral substrates like fibre cement, aerated concrete, gypsum and thin rendering such as Sika® MonoTop®-723 N, Monotop FC, etc. Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer can also be used as a primer on firmly adhering existing water based coatings or under cement resurfacing mortar to improve the adhesion in case of concrete surface treated with hydrophobic impregnation. Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer is part of a system:
    - Suitable for protection against ingress (Principle 1, method 1.3 of EN 1504-9),
    - Suitable for moisture control (Principle 2, method 2.3 of EN 1504-9)
    - Suitable for increasing the resistivity (Principle 8, method 8.3 of EN 1504-9)
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.6.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Water based primer for coating
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Test report from IBAC Aachen dd 07.04.1993 in combination with Sikagard®-545 W Elastofill.
    - Test report acc. ZTV-SIB OS DII from the Polymer Institute dd 16.10.0; Nr. P 2703/01-125.
    - Protective coating according to EN 1504-2, DoP 02 03 03 06 002 0 000002 1125; certified by Factory Production Control Body: 0921; certificate 0921-BPR- 2046 and provided with the CE-marking
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 1504-2: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1); Description (p.1).
    - EN 1504-9: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Uses (p.1).
    - EN 1542: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Application Instructions > SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Water dispersed - solvent-free
    - Environmentally friendly
    - Water vapour permeable
    - Can be used as an adhesion promoter for coating or cement based resurfacing mortar
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Acrylate dispersion
    - Appearance and colour: Milky white liquid
    - Density: ~1.0 kg/l (at 20 °C)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Solid content by volume: ~20 %
2.7 System structure. 1 × Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 15 lt pail
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production if stored properly in undamaged and unopened original sealed packaging.
    - Storage conditions: Store in cool and dry conditions. Protect from direct sunlight and frost.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment. The substrate must be dense and free from loose and friable particles. Tensile strength of the substrate must be more than 1 N/mm². Exposed concrete without existing coating; Suitable preparation methods are steam cleaning, high pressure water jetting or blastcleaning. New concrete must be at least 28 days old. Thin layer renderings; If required, a levelling pore sealer (e.g. Sika® MonoTop®-723 N, Sika® MonoTop®- FC, Sikagard®-550 W , etc.) shall be applied – refer to the respective product data sheet. For cement based products, allow a curing time of at least 4 days before priming. Exposed concrete with existing coating; Existing coatings must be tested to confirm their adhesion to the substrate - adhesion test average: > 1.0 N/mm² with no single value below 0.7 N/mm2 for subsequent top rigid coating; > 0.8 N/mm² with no single value below 0.5 N/mm² for subsequent top elastic coating respectively – refer to the relevant Method Statement for more details.
    - For water based coating, use Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer as primer
    - For solvent based coating, use Sikagard®-551 S Elastic Primer - refer to separate data sheet
    - In case of doubt, carry out adherence testing to determine which primer is most suitable - wait at least 2 weeks after application prior to conduct the adhesion test as per EN 1542

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: ~0.10–0.12 kg/m² (~8–10 m² per litre) dependent on the absorbency of the substrate.
4.3 Waiting time to overcoating. Waiting time before coating:
    | Substrate temperature | Time |
    | +8 °C | 12 hours |
    | +20 °C | 5 hours |
    | +35 °C | 2.5 hours |
    | Use only water dispersed coating systems on top of Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer. |
    | When used as primer under cement based resurfacing mortar, apply the mortar when the primer is still tacky. If the primer has dried out completely, re-apply 1 coat |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Note: When application is on existing coating, waiting time prior to overcoat the primer will increase by 100%.
4.4 Application.
    - Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer is supplied ready for use; do not dilute it. Shake it thoroughly prior to apply it.
    - Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer can be applied by brush, roller or airless spray.
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with clean water immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be removed mechanically.
4.6 Limitations and important considerations - Do not apply when there is.
    - Expected rain
    - Concrete younger than 28 days
    Do not apply a resurfacing mortar onto Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer that has dried out - the bonding of the mortar might be impaired

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +8 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.3 Relative air humidity. < 80 %
5.4 Dew point. Substrate and ambient temperature must be at least 3 °C above dew point.
5.5 Substrate temperature. +8 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.6 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.6):
    - Expected rain
5.7 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Existing coatings must be tested to confirm their adhesion to the substrate - adhesion test average: > 1.0 N/mm² with no single value below 0.7 N/mm2 for subsequent top rigid coating; > 0.8 N/mm² with no single value below 0.5 N/mm² for subsequent top elastic coating respectively – refer to the relevant Method Statement for more details.
    - In case of doubt, carry out adherence testing to determine which primer is most suitable - wait at least 2 weeks after application prior to conduct the adhesion test as per EN 1542
5.8 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.9 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer, April 2023, Version 03.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikagard_-552_w_aquaprimer.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
